text_block_list.name: C.B. & Ace
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaah!! Uooooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A staggering feat! Japan's first Japan Cup 
champion is Mr. C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aaaah...! That was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...!! Nwaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit, dammit, dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time. If I break now, it's 
over... Next time, for sure..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Next time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! CB is so strong~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace put on a great race too! I 
loved seeing all that grit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, CB really is strong! They say 
Rudolf is coming, but CB's not done—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Rudolf isn't running today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
? That might be true, but... Still, CB 
won, so shouldn't you just be happy?!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yeah. Sorry, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "CB! What race are you running next?!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Always jumping the gun, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Just hurry up and tell me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. Actually, I've already decided. 
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You know full well. It's the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Rudolf, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She told me she wants to race. Ace, 
the current Rudolf is strong.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Achieving an undefeated Triple Crown, 
followed by countless accolades—the more 
the world demands a champion in Rudolf, 
the stronger she becomes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf was simply that kind of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...... What's that supposed to mean?! You 
too—?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You run too, Ace! I don't wanna do it 
unless you're in it, too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Today was genuinely so much fun. Running 
right next to you when you're like an 
absolute demon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I want you there too. Let's run through 
that grand stage together, the three of 
us.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No good?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I-It's... not hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I am not done yet, and...! I'm gonna blow 
right through all the expectations you're 
carrying!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wash your neck and wait for me, C.B.! 
Don't just keep your eyes on Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, what are you talking about, Ace?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I learned today, more than I ever wanted 
to, just what you're capable of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Our next target race is the Arima Kinen. 
The grand year-end stage at Nakayama...!
